exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at sides
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead

exercises.name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart
Drive one knee up towards chest
Quickly switch to the other knee

exercises.name: Burpees
instructions: Drop into a squat and place hands on floor
Jump feet back into plank position
Do a push-up then jump feet forward and jump up

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Drive one knee towards your chest
Keep your core tight and hips level

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Stand tall and jog in place
Kick your heels up towards your glutes

exercises.name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold rope handles at hip height
Swing rope overhead and jump with both feet
Land softly on balls of feet

exercises.name: Skater Jumps
instructions: Jump sideways to the opposite leg

exercises.name: Box Jumps
instructions: Bend knees and swing arms back

exercises.name: Star Jumps
instructions: Squat down with arms at sides
Jump up explosively spreading arms and legs
Land softly back into squat position

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffles
instructions: Shuffle back to the other side

exercises.name: Push-Ups
instructions: Start in plank position with hands shoulder-width apart
Lower your chest towards the floor
Push back up to starting position
Keep your body in a straight line

exercises.name: Wide Push-Ups
instructions: Place hands wider than shoulder-width apart

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Ups
instructions: Place hands close together forming a diamond shape
Great for triceps and inner chest

exercises.name: Decline Push-Ups
instructions: Place feet on an elevated surface

exercises.name: Chest Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself up
Push back up to starting position

exercises.name: Chest Press
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbells at chest level

exercises.name: Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells above chest
Open arms wide in an arc motion
Bring weights back together above chest

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with hands behind head
Bring right elbow to left knee
Switch to left elbow and right knee

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Keep body in a straight line

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with forearm on ground

exercises.name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie flat on back with legs straight
Lower legs slowly without touching floor

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on back with legs extended
Lift legs slightly off the ground
Kick legs up and down alternately

exercises.name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit with knees bent and feet off floor
Touch hands to floor on each side

exercises.name: V-Ups
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended overhead
Simultaneously lift legs and upper body

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back with arms and knees raised
Return to start and switch sides
Keep lower back flat on floor

exercises.name: Toe Touches
instructions: Lie on back with legs raised to 90 degrees
Reach hands up to touch toes

exercises.name: Heel Touches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent
Reach one hand to touch same side heel

exercises.name: Plank Jacks
instructions: Jump feet out wide then back together

exercises.name: Squats
instructions: Lower your hips back and down
Keep chest up and knees over toes
Push through heels to stand up

exercises.name: Lunges
instructions: Push through front heel to stand

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
instructions: Push through front heel to return

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Push off back foot to step forward into next lunge

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Slide down until thighs are parallel to floor

exercises.name: Step-Ups
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench

exercises.name: Sumo Squats
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes pointed out
Keep chest up and back straight

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curls
instructions: Curl the other leg behind you

exercises.name: Side Lunges
instructions: Bend stepping leg and push hips back
Push back to start and alternate

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with one leg extended
Push hips up using one leg

exercises.name: Donkey Kicks
instructions: Kick one leg up towards ceiling
Squeeze glute at top and lower

exercises.name: Fire Hydrants
instructions: Lift one knee out to the side

exercises.name: Hip Thrusts
instructions: Lean upper back against a bench
Place feet flat on floor hip-width apart

exercises.name: Froggy Glute Lifts
instructions: Lie face down with knees bent and soles together
Squeeze glutes to lift thighs off floor

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other
Curl weights up keeping palms neutral

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Place hands on edge of bench behind you

exercises.name: Tricep Kickbacks
instructions: Bend forward at waist with dumbbell

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower weight behind head bending elbows

exercises.name: Close Grip Push-Ups
instructions: Place hands close together under chest

exercises.name: Wrist Curls
instructions: Rest forearms on thighs palms up
Curl wrists up lifting the weight

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
instructions: Raise arms out to sides to shoulder height

exercises.name: Front Raises
instructions: Raise arms forward to shoulder height
Alternate or do both arms together

exercises.name: Pike Push-Ups
instructions: Bend elbows and lower head towards floor

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Grip bar with palms facing away
Pull body up until chin over bar

exercises.name: Chin-Ups
instructions: Grip bar with palms facing you
Pull body up until chin over bar

exercises.name: Bent Over Rows
instructions: Bend forward at waist with dumbbells
Pull weights up to sides of chest

exercises.name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended
Lift arms legs and chest off floor

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
instructions: Pull bar down to upper chest

exercises.name: Back Extensions
instructions: Lie face down with hands behind head
Lift upper body off the floor

exercises.name: Inverted Rows
instructions: Lie under a bar or sturdy table
Grip bar and pull chest up to it

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at hips and grip the weight
Drive through heels to stand up
Lower weight back down with control

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering
Move forward using opposite hand and foot
Keep hips low and core tight

exercises.name: Plank to Push-Up
instructions: Push up to full plank one arm at a time

exercises.name: Inchworms
instructions: Bend down and walk hands out to plank
Walk hands back to feet and stand

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on back holding weight above chest
Stand up while keeping weight overhead
Reverse the motion to lie back down

exercises.name: Man Makers
instructions: Start in push-up position holding dumbbells
Do a push-up then row each arm

exercises.name: Quad Stretch
instructions: Pull other foot to your glute

exercises.name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on floor with toes together

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Arch back up like a cat
Then drop belly down and look up

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Feel stretch in front of hip

exercises.name: Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Bring one arm across your chest
Use other hand to pull it closer

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with hands under shoulders

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
instructions: From all fours bring one knee forward

exercises.name: Downward Dog
instructions: Straighten legs and press heels down

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width
Hinge hips and swing kettlebell between legs
Thrust hips forward to swing weight up

exercises.name: Renegade Rows
instructions: Start in push-up position on dumbbells
Row one dumbbell up to hip
Lower and row the other side

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Keep shoulders back and core tight

exercises.name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells extended overhead
Lower weights towards forehead bending elbows

exercises.name: Concentration Curls
instructions: Sit with elbow against inner thigh

exercises.name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells at chest palms facing you
End with palms facing forward overhead

exercises.name: Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat
Cross arms over chest or behind head
Curl entire torso up to sitting position

exercises.name: Reverse Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with legs raised and knees bent
Curl hips off the floor towards chest
Keep upper back flat on floor

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunges
instructions: Step one leg behind and across the other
Push back up and alternate sides

exercises.name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench with feet flat on floor
Grip barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower bar to chest with control
Press bar back up to starting position
